primary_metric: Final proposed verdict accuracy, with abstention incorrect in full denominator, separate per dataset/arm.
workflow_adaptation: Spec Kit arms run four real project-policy stages once per dataset/arm; ordinary baseline writes one generic policy brief within the same four-call maximum setup allowance. Every arm uses fixed two-call draft/review implementation per case. Spec Kit arms use shipped commands/templates and execute Python scaffolding/prerequisite helpers; AEE arm invokes released extension/engine and single-result Evaluator composition during policy and case review. Actual setup overhead remains measured, not padded away. No claim of unmodified coding workflow per response.
guard: Protocol/infrastructure/identity/source/cap faults halt immediately. Wrong factual classifications and valid AEE iterate/gather_evidence outcomes are retained measured outcomes, never relabelled or retried.
prior_exposure: Same public240case selection already has a published model-only one-call result. New equal-budget controls are rerun prospectively; policy generators cannot see cases, gold, previous predictions, metrics or sibling policies. This is not untouched-test discovery or independent replication.
acceptance: All policy documents and model judgments remain drafts; no human acceptance, protected authority or promotion is synthesized. Nonpassing AEE outcomes remain nonpassing. Gate-eligible view abstains unless AEE outcome is pass/warn; raw proposed verdict accuracy remains separately reported.
selection: Unchanged committed selection-v1.json and original upstream author labels. No selection/prompt/threshold tuning from partial matched outputs.
